en.title: Minimum Cards to Add for Even Card Packs
en.description:
There are several kinds of cards, each with a given count. Choose at least 2 packs and, only by adding cards, make every kind of card split evenly among all packs. Find the minimum total number of cards to add.

The standard input/output format and examples were compiled by this site; ranges explicitly marked as this site's are not the source's original constraints.
en.input: The first line contains n, and the second line contains n counts. 1≤n≤100000, 1≤count≤500.
hints: Count the frequency of each count value, enumerate the number of packs from 2 to max(2,largest count), and the cost is Σ frequency×((packs−count%packs)%packs).
